the immunohistochemical analysis of endometrial cancer using a monoclonally derived antibody to the estrogen receptor provides a sensitive and specific method for evaluating estrogen receptor content in endometrial cancer.

the use of monoclonal antibodies for the immunohistochemical localization and quantification of estrogen receptor in human endometrial carcinoma.
the immunohistochemical localization and quantification of estrogen receptors in endometrial carcinoma, using a monoclonl antibody, H222.
the development of monoclonal antibodies to human estrogen receptor and their use in the analysis of estrogen receptor in human endometrial cancer.
